summary: Feed s072_single to SIEM is degraded: required VLAN 20 is not present and 51% of packets are untagged, creating a blind spot for VLAN 20 detection coverage. All other visibility checks (duplicates, encryption, one-way, oversize, drops, overload, truncation, tunnels) are healthy.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker or TAP/SPAN ingress is stripping 802.1Q tags or is configured as access/untagged instead of trunk, so VLAN 20 tags are removed before delivery to the SIEM. 51% untagged indicates systematic tag stripping, not occasional missing traffic.
findings.impact_on_tool: SIEM cannot filter, correlate, or apply VLAN-aware rules for VLAN 20; traffic from VLAN 20 appears as untagged and is misattributed or ignored, reducing detection coverage for that segment despite SIEM not requiring full payload or bidirectional flow.

recommended_fix.why: Preserve and forward 802.1Q tags for VLANs 10 and 20 through TAP and packet broker trunk ports so SIEM receives correctly tagged traffic and regains visibility into VLAN 20.
